description: Explains a failed PCI ASV scan finding and how to fix it, for the ten most common causes: certificates, old TLS, unpatched software, open ports, default credentials, version banners, missing headers, insecure remote access, DNS and mail, and injection flaws. Pass the finding text from the scan report, or an issue name, or neither to list all ten.

finding.description: The finding as the scan report words it, for example "TLS Version 1.0 Protocol Detection".

issue.description: The category, when the caller already knows it.

name: fix_failed_scan
title: Fix a failed PCI ASV scan
